scenes.voice: In this guide, we’ll create a QR code with SmartToolz from input to download.
Open the SmartToolz QR Code Generator and use the main input field. Enter the content you want to encode.
For this example, I’m using the SmartToolz website address. Review the available options and choose the settings you need.
Keep the result easy to scan. Then click Generate.
The QR code appears in the result area. Check the preview and make sure it is clear and readable.
Before publishing, test the finished code with a phone camera. This helps catch problems before people scan it.
That’s it. Use the SmartToolz QR Generator whenever you need a quick QR code.
Visit the SmartToolz Knowledge Base for more practical guides.
